text.fr: Apprendre, puis mettre en pratique au moment voulu : n'est-ce pas une joie ?

cta.en: Follow @shinsegi.en — a new story every day

scenes.image_prompt: empty stone courtyard at dawn, low mist, wooden gate, long shot

narration.en: To learn and then to practice it in due time — is that not a pleasure. — Confucius.
narration.ko: 배우고 때때로 익히면, 또한 기쁘지 아니한가. — 공자.

scenes.image_prompt: apartment window at dawn, thin curtain, small figure standing, long shot

narration.en: Tomorrow I'll start. I've said that a hundred times
narration.ko: 내일부터 하겠다. 그 말을 나는 백 번 했다
narration.zh-cn: 明天就开始。这句话我说了一百遍。

scenes.image_prompt: narrow alley in morning, bicycle against wall, seen from behind, long shot

narration.en: I opened the book at the end of the alley.
narration.zh-cn: 巷子尽头，我翻开了那本书。

scenes.image_prompt: desk by a window in daylight, open book, seen from behind, wide shot

narration.en: Not one line came in. I closed it.
narration.zh-cn: 一行也读不进去。我合上了。

scenes.image_prompt: concrete stairwell, cold light, sitting figure, long shot

narration.en: I sat on the stairs and did nothing.
narration.zh-cn: 坐在楼梯上，什么也没做。

scenes.image_prompt: bus stop in the afternoon, empty bench, distant figure sitting, wide shot

narration.en: At the bus stop I took the book out again.
narration.zh-cn: 在公交站，我又把那本书拿出来。

scenes.image_prompt: small kitchen at night, one lamp, cup on table, seen from behind, long shot

narration.en: In the kitchen that night I read the same line.
narration.zh-cn: 那天夜里，在厨房读同一行。

scenes.image_prompt: office desk corner at night, stacked papers, distant small figure, wide shot

narration.en: Paper piled one sheet a day in the desk corner.
narration.ko: 책상 구석에 종이가 한 장씩 쌓였다.

scenes.image_prompt: night window from the street, one light on, distant figure, long shot

narration.en: I know what sits in that corner now.
narration.ko: 지금 그 더미가 무엇인지 나는 안다.
narration.zh-cn: 桌角那堆东西，我现在知道是什么。

narration.en: What I read fades. What I did stays in the hands.
